course.title: Materials Manufacturing Processes
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: A strip with a cross-section of 150mm x 6mm is being rolled with 20% reduction of area, using 400mm diameter steel rolls. Before and after rolling, the shear yield stress of the material is 0.35 kN/mm²and 0.4 kN/mm² respectively. Calculate:
(ii)The average shear yield stress during process
(iii)The angle subtended by the deformation zone at the roll center
(iv)The location of the neutral point θ.
Assume the coefficient of friction to be 0.1

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
